THE REPRESENTATION IS REAL AND IT CARRIES NOTHING. The field is signed by what the drug
does -- 762 inhibitory, 269 activating -- and propagated to a dense response reaching
1061x as many genes as the drug has targets, correlating 0.019 with the raw target vector.
P1 confirms it is genuinely a different object. Then: the signs are worth -0.0100, the
network over a degree-preserving shuffle +0.0003, and propagation over no
propagation at all -0.0013. Every piece of the mechanism is worth zero.
AND THE AXIS FLIP DID THE OPPOSITE OF WHAT I ARGUED. The claim written into this file
before it ran was that scoring per TERM makes effect count structurally unable to help.
It reaches 0.7913, against 0.5408 for the field and 0.5022 for the null. A drug with
three hundred listed effects is more likely to carry ANY given effect than one with ten,
so fixing the term does not cancel the count -- it is nearly the definition of term
membership. The confound went from 0.2898 on the old axis to 0.7913 on this one.
Four attempts at this row have now failed on the same quantity, three of them on designs
built specifically to be immune to it, and this one made it worse.
